text: Long catch up with Moira on the phone. Her and Graham hit 25 years on June 3rd and the kids are throwing them a surprise lunch. She thinks Graham suspects nothing. Need to send a card before then. Also she mentioned her brother is visiting from Inverness this weekend, first time in years, and she's not sure where to put him.

Coffee with Andre. His sister Zara got engaged on Saturday, proposal on a beach in Portugal apparently. Wedding probably next summer. He's chuffed for her but dreading the best man-ish speech he's been roped into. His mum keeps phoning him with ideas. We said we'd meet for a run next Tuesday.
Ben rang. Wedding's off, him and Ellie split up last month. He sounded flat but said his mum's been brilliant. Remind me to ask him out for a pint next week.

Chioma's mum is coming over from Lagos on 5/14 for three weeks. Chioma is nervous about her meeting Florin's family for the first time, big dinner planned that Sunday. Florin's dad is apparently very formal. Chioma's asked me for a good jollof recipe so she can impress everyone, which I need to send her tonight.
Kate and Patrick's anniversary is Friday. Six years. Kate keeps saying Patrick would love a decent coffee grinder, worth remembering for Christmas too.
Quick one: Ayesha's brother Nikhil starts his new job in Leeds on Monday. She's helping him move this weekend.

Talked to Florin after football. His dad has his hip op on Tuesday and Florin's driving up to Cluj on Thursday to be with him. He's pretty worried. Don't forget to text him Tuesday evening to see how the op went.
Archie and Mabel are visiting the week of July 8th. I'm doing the spare room up for them.
Alina's daughter Freya graduates from Edinburgh on June 27th. Alina's flying up the day before with her partner Julien. She's already cried about it twice.
Jess told me at lunch she and Tendai are expecting, due in March. Haven't seen her that happy in ages. Her nan's knitting already.
Julien said his parents' 40th anniversary party is at the end of the month and the whole family is coming over from Lyon. He's in charge of the playlist and stressing about it.
Anya called about the hen do. It's the weekend of August 16th in Bath, Carmen is organising. Need to pay the deposit to Carmen by Friday.
Must ring Uncle Dafydd on Sunday, it's his 70th next Wednesday and I want to sort the present with Mum before then.
Carmen and Louis's wedding was gorgeous. Louis cried through the vows. Should send them the photos from my phone tomorrow.
Lunch with Amir. His wife Aoife is having her wisdom teeth out on Thursday so he's working from home that day. His boss isn't thrilled about it. Amir's into bouldering now, goes three nights a week.
Dentist moved to next Tuesday 9am. Pick up the dry cleaning Saturday.

Saw Siddharth at the station. His brother Nikhil is getting married in Pune on December 12th and the whole family's going for a fortnight. Sid's never been to India in winter. Told him I'd look after his cat Biscuit while they're away. Need to get a spare key off him before the 10th.
Naledi's little boy started nursery this week and has cried every morning. She's exhausted and back at work full time on the 3rd. Remind me to drop round with dinner one evening next week.
Divya said her parents are renewing their vows on their 30th, sometime in late April. She wants to make them a photo book. I said I'd help scan the old prints.

Leah was quiet at book club. Turns out her engagement's been called off, her and Ben agreed it wasn't right. She's staying at her sister's for now. I should check in with her this weekend, just a text.
Graham mentioned he's retiring at the end of September after 32 years at the council. There's a do on 9/26 at the rugby club.

Catch up with Ellie and Jen. Ellie's mum got the all clear from her scan on Monday, massive relief. Jen's moving to Bristol in a fortnight with her girlfriend Kate. We're doing a leaving meal Thursday the 18th. Need to book the table at Dishoom tomorrow.
Patrick's dog Rolo has his op tomorrow morning, Patrick's a wreck.
Remind me to ask Tendai how his driving test went, it was this morning.
Andre Okafor called back about the flat. Viewing Saturday 11am, I'll bring the deposit.

Moira's daughter Chioma, Chi to everyone, is getting married in October. Moira says Chi's fiancé Amir is lovely but his family are a lot. The engagement party is May 30th at their house. I'm bringing a cake. Moira's also got her sister staying with her till Friday, so the house is chaos.
Tried to call Ayesha back twice, no luck. Try again tomorrow after 6.
Florin is learning the cello at 41 and loves it. His wife says he practises in the shed.
Mabel's grandson Archie is home from uni for the summer on June 9th. She's thrilled, already planning roasts.

Kate rang to say Patrick proposed! On Tuesday, at the restaurant where they had their first date. They're thinking spring, maybe April 4th. Her mum doesn't know yet, they're telling both families on Sunday. Need to send flowers and a proper congrats card.

Long walk with Alina. She's been struggling since the miscarriage in August and only told a few people. Her husband Louis has been great but he's back travelling for work next week. She mentioned she's started pottery on Wednesday nights which helps. Her sister Anya is coming to stay for the weekend of the 21st. I want to check in on Tuesday when Louis has gone, maybe suggest a walk.
Jess said Julien's brother is doing the London marathon in April for his late dad's charity.
Zara's mum and dad have their 50th anniversary on 3/18. Big party planned but Zara thinks her dad would rather a quiet one. Don't forget to ask Zara if they've got a date for the party yet.
Ben's kids are doing a nativity on Thursday afternoon. He's taking the afternoon off. His youngest is a sheep and very serious about it.
Dafydd says his wife Mabel loves anything with lavender. Birthday's in May.
Groceries, bins out tonight, renew passport before the Lisbon trip on the 2nd.
Met up with Carmen Reyes. She's nervous about her citizenship interview on Monday. Her husband Graham's coming along for moral support. I said I'd text her good luck Sunday night.
Aoife and Siddharth celebrated ten years together last weekend, went to Dublin for it. They showed me photos of the cliffs. Aoife's mum minded the kids. Sid wants to go back for New Year.
Amir's dad is in hospital again with his chest. Amir's going down on Friday, back Monday. Remind me to ring him Saturday.
Nikhil and Freya are hosting their first Thanksgiving this year since Freya's American, Thursday the 26th. Invited me and Leah. I'm doing the pies.
Jen's son Louis turns 7 on November 2nd and is obsessed with dinosaurs and Lego. Jen hinted a Lego T rex would win him over forever.

Talked to Divya. Her brother Siddharth and his wife have just had a baby girl, Asha, born Sunday morning. Divya's flying out to see them in a fortnight. Divya says her mum has already booked a flight for tomorrow.

Called Archie. His mum's funeral is next Friday at St Mary's, 2pm. He's holding it together but only just. His partner Ellie is handling most of the arrangements. I'll go. I should also send something to Ellie to say thanks for keeping me posted.
Andre and his husband Ben adopted a rescue greyhound called Pip on Saturday. Andre's already sending me twenty photos a day.
Chioma's dinner party on Saturday's been called off, her boyfriend's down with flu. She'll rearrange for after Patrick's birthday.

Freya's sister Alina is doing her first triathlon in Windermere on September 7th. Freya says she's been training like mad but is terrified of the open water swim. Must message Alina the day before to wish her luck.
Leah's vegan now, and her partner Dafydd's gluten free. Keep in mind for the barbecue.

Tendai moved into the new place with his brother on the 1st. Still no wifi, he's been working from cafés. His mum came to help unpack and stayed four days, which he found a lot. He's having people round for a housewarming on Friday 10/17.
Note to self, cancel the gym membership before the 30th.

Spoke to Ayesha Patel this morning. Her parents' anniversary dinner on Saturday went really well, the whole family turned up, even her cousin from Toronto. Her dad gave a speech. I should ask her for the photos.

Grabbed lunch with Naledi and Jess. Jess has her final PhD viva on April 22nd and is quietly panicking. Naledi got the promotion to head of research, starts in the new role after the summer. Both of them are knackered. Need to book something fun for the three of us in May once Jess is done, maybe the spa.
Kate's cousin Archie is moving to Melbourne next Tuesday, for good. Kate's mum is taking it hard.
Aoife's wedding anniversary is the same day as mine, June 14th. Funny coincidence.
Graham Hughes from next door said his granddaughter Ellie got into Cambridge. He's bursting with pride. Remind me to pop a card through his door this week.

Phone call with Mum. Auntie Moira's having her knee done on August 5th, and Uncle Patrick's not great with hospitals, so Mum's going to stay with them that week. Mum also said cousin Jess is engaged, to a guy called Florin. Florin's apparently a chef. I need to ring Moira the night before the op, and send Jess something nice.
Julien's twins started secondary school yesterday. He said Anya was fine but Louis came home very quiet.

Dinner with Zara and Nikhil. Zara's new job in Manchester starts on the 6th, she's commuting from home for the first month. Nikhil's mum is moving in with them after Christmas, which Zara is trying to be relaxed about. Nikhil's really into sourdough at the moment, brought a loaf.
Mabel's 90th is next Saturday. Her son Dafydd is coming from Cardiff. Cake ordered, I'm collecting it Friday.
Divya said Carmen is struggling a bit with the new baby and not sleeping. Her husband's away a lot for work.

Ellie mentioned her parents are visiting from Galway this weekend and next weekend she's off to Freya's wedding in Devon. Then on May 20th she starts her new job. Remind me to text her on the 20th to see how the first day went.
